server.name: demo-boards-mcp
server.description: Kusto / Azure Data Explorer query tools for the codeboxTesting security telemetry dataset

tools.name: kusto.query
tools.title: Kusto Query
tools.description: Run a read-only KQL query against the configured Azure Data Explorer database and return the primary result table as rows. Defaults to the codeboxTesting database on the kendradatasets.eastus cluster.

query.description: The KQL query to execute (e.g. 'SigninLogs | take 10').

database.description: Optional database override. Defaults to the configured database (codeboxTesting).

maxRows.description: Maximum number of result rows to return. Default 500.

tools.name: kusto.list_tables
tools.title: Kusto List Tables
tools.description: List the table names available in the configured Azure Data Explorer database (codeboxTesting by default).

database.description: Optional database override. Defaults to the configured database (codeboxTesting).

tools.name: kusto.get_schema
tools.title: Kusto Get Table Schema
tools.description: Return the column schema (CSL schema) for a single table in the configured Azure Data Explorer database.

database.description: Optional database override. Defaults to the configured database (codeboxTesting).
